definitions.explanation: Indicates that a product contains no added fragrance or perfume. Composed of 無 (without) + 香料 (fragrance/perfume). Common on product labels for cosmetics, detergents, and personal care items.

examples.japanese: {無香料|むこうりょう}の{石鹸|せっけん}を{使|つか}っている。
{肌|はだ}が{弱|よわ}いので、{無香料|むこうりょう}の{化粧品|けしょうひん}を{選|えら}んでいる。
examples.english: Since I have sensitive skin, I choose fragrance-free cosmetics.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃん{用|よう}の{洗剤|せんざい}は{無香料|むこうりょう}・{無着色|むちゃくしょく}のものが{安心|あんしん}だ。
examples.english: For baby detergent, fragrance-free and dye-free products are safest.

notes:
USAGE:
{無香料|むこうりょう} is used as a no-adjective to modify nouns: {無香料|むこうりょう}の{製品|せいひん} (fragrance-free product). It appears frequently on product labels and in advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無香料|むこうりょう}・{無着色|むちゃくしょく} (fragrance-free and dye-free)
- {無香料|むこうりょう}タイプ (unscented type)
- {無香料|むこうりょう}の{洗剤|せんざい} (fragrance-free detergent)

RELATED TERMS:
- {香料|こうりょう} (fragrance, perfume ingredient)
- {無添加|むてんか} (additive-free)
- {低刺激|ていしげき} (hypoallergenic, low-irritation)
